# form-fill-kit

> Fill forms from agent-proposed values with typed validation, a human confirmation summary bound to a SHA-256 digest of the exact values and single-use submission Python package `trysac-form-fill-kit`, import name `form_fill_kit`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
